title: A composition of standard smooth ring maps is standard smooth
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that composing two standard smooth ring maps gives a standard smooth ring map (statement lines 37589-37592). The proof does not invoke the characterisation of smoothness by the cotangent complex: it fuses the two presentations into a single one by lifting the second set of relations to the larger polynomial ring, writes down the resulting Jacobian, observes that it is block triangular with the two known Jacobians on the diagonal, and concludes that its determinant is invertible as a product (proof lines 37594-37652). Seeing the block triangular shape of the fused presentation is the content. H2.
